question: Spectrum Organics brand owner manufacturer
markdown:
The Spectrum brand (Spectrum Organics, Spectrum Culinary, and Spectrum Essentials) is owned and manufactured by
The Hain Celestial Group
, a leading organic and natural products company that acquired Spectrum Organic Products in 2005.
